description: UWWTD - Čistírny odpadních vod is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Výzkumný ústav vodohospodářský T. G. Masaryka veřejná výzkumná instituce. The data set contains individual data on wastewater treatment plants in agglomerations above 2000 EO, including sites without connection to the collecting system, including information on wastewater treatment capacity, type of treatment, nitrogen and phosphorus removal and data on treatment efficiency. Coverage: Výzkumný ústav vodohospodářský T. G. Masaryka veřejná výzkumná instituce. The portal shows the English title as "UWWTD - UWWTPs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Výzkumný ústav vodohospodářský T. G. Masaryka veřejná výzkumná instituce. Its keywords include Utility and governmental services, Veřejné služby a služby veřejné správy, Národní, National. The listing shows 4 download or service links in SHP, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00020711/44df80c89b568d03def2ab953ceb023d/distribuce/5fa4a1d39831e56559f4d576525b8072/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
